name: Wallenhorst (Germany)
description: White field with narrow green stripes along the top and bottom edges, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Wallenhorst (a white cross between lozenges on green).
history: The arms, designed by Hans-Heinrich Reclam, were granted by the Regierungspräsident in Osnabrück in 1973.

features.role: Wallenhorst arms — cross and lozenges on green
